title: Aeron Region
description: Aeron Region is a small Cobbleverse SMP built around a relaxed community, player progression, and long-term survival!
body:
Minecraft Server IP: HMAC.mc.gg
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/WcgZA5QqQr

**COBBLEMON MODPACK DOWNLOAD**
CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/cobbleverse-cobblemon
ModRinth: https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobbleverse

We’re currently a solid group of around 3–10 active players looking to expand and bring in more people who want to help shape the server early. The server is still growing, so now is a good time to join if you like being part of a community before everything is already fully established.

We have daily server backups, so builds and progress are protected. We’re also starting to develop player-driven gyms, where players can build their own gyms, create teams, and eventually help form a full Gym Leader → Elite Four → Champion style progression.

Features:

-Cobbleverse 1.7.31
-Shiny starters
-Player gyms in development
-Ranked battles
-Community events
-Daily backups
-New player-friendly
-No pay-to-win ranks or paid Pokémon

We’re not trying to be some massive over-polished network. Just a growing server with people building, battling, collecting, and slowly turning the region into something fun.

If this suits your taste feel free to join!
